condition.description: Same condition shape as event-flag.schema.json (#12) so the two systems read each other.

description: One evolution edge. The world model is a single edge list: branching (1->n) and convergence (n->1) are properties of the list, not special cases. Field naming follows the core data convention (camelCase). trigger stays null until canon sets it — prose existence is never converted into numbers by tooling.

from.description: Core species id/slug of the earlier stage.

methodClass.description: growth = the wave-1 sheets' own class (no special trigger). item/trade/place/time ship as vocabulary with zero asserted canon instances to date.

representation.description: OWNER_DECISION only where the line breaks one-creature-in/one-creature-out (A9 pair-merge).

status.description: Provenance in the core convention, naming the source the edge was derived from.

to.description: Core species id/slug of the later stage.

trigger.description: The method's operand as data — {level:n} / {item:id} / {location:areaId} / {bondCount:n} — null until canon sets it.

title: Mochiichao evolution edge
